title: Evolve inline number & masked inputs: grouping, cursor, and validation affordances
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Our current textfield and mask primitives (credit-card, phone, numeric) behave inconsistently across density modes: cursor jumps when auto-formatting groups, clear/copy affordances are misplaced in compact mode, and validation states are visually ambiguous when masked characters are present. This leads to developer confusion, frequent engineering workarounds, and accessibility regressions for screen-reader users.

Goal: Define a cohesive pattern for grouping and masking behaviors for numeric and masked inputs that: 1) prevents cursor/selection jumps during auto-formatting, 2) exposes clear and copy affordances consistently across density tokens, 3) provides deterministic validation priority and messaging for partially-completed masks, and 4) preserves screen-reader semantics and input method editor (IME) behavior for international users.

Scope: UI/UX patterns, token decisions (spacing, hit targets), microcopy for error/help states, ARIA conventions, a small set of updated components (TextField, MaskedInput, NumericInput), and a migration guide for existing usages. Implementation work (engineering) will be separate but this ticket contains final designs, acceptance criteria, and handoff artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Cursor stability: typing, deleting, and pasting retain logical caret position in grouping formats (e.g., credit card 4-4-4-4, phone 3-3-4) across Compact, Default, and Spacious density tokens.
Affordance parity: clear, reveal, and copy actions render and hit-test consistently within the input container in compact density without overlapping helper text or prefix/suffix tokens.
Validation precedence: show inline syntax validation (format) before semantic validation (Luhn, length) and provide a single accessible error message announced via aria-live when appropriate.
Screen reader semantics: masked inputs expose a readout policy (announce last 4 digits, or use 'one character hidden' pattern) configurable via prop, with documentation on privacy trade-offs.
Localization: grouping and numeral formatting guides documented for right-to-left and locales using non-latin numerals; developers can opt-out of automatic grouping for specific locales.
Design tokens: spacing, icon sizes, and hit target recommendations added to tokens roadmap and cross-referenced in component spec.
Migration doc: at least three example migrations (billing form, payment modal, account phone field) with code snippets and Figma redlines.
Design review: sign-off from Accessibility lead (Noah Rivera) and PM (Jonah Kim) recorded in comments.
design_notes: Prefer non-destructive auto-formatting: format on blur and paste; incremental grouping while typing should not reposition the caret backward. Provide optional toggle prop for always-format-as-you-type for developer opt-in.
Show grouping separators visually but keep them non-selectable so keyboard copy/paste yields raw digits unless developer opts into 'punctuated copy'.

Compact density: reduce horizontal padding to tokens.compact.inputPadding but keep icon hit targets at minimum 24px. Move transient helper text to floating microline to avoid overlap with suffix actions.
Validation microcopy: split messages into two levels: inline short hint and expanded assistive message (shown on focus-with-error) to reduce noise in forms with multiple masked fields.
Provide explicit guidance for masked reveal: must be gated behind a secure flag for high-risk inputs (SSN, full credit card) and default to reveal-only-last4 for payment flows.

Tradeoffs considered: always-format-as-you-type aids discoverability but increases complexity for IME and some right-to-left locales; decision is to default to format-on-blur and provide opt-in props.
engineering_notes: Edge cases to handle: composition events from IME (compositionstart/compositionend), programmatic value sets, and input type=tel vs type=text differences on mobile browsers.
Recommend kernel: expose 'formatStrategy' prop with values: 'format-on-blur' (default), 'format-as-you-type', 'no-format' and an 'announcePolicy' prop for screen readers.
Performance: grouping should be performed with local JS (no network) and avoid setState loops causing re-rendering; provide unit tests for caret restoration algorithm.
Backend: no schema changes expected. Add telemetry events for 'mask-reveal' and 'format-mode' toggles (opt-in) to help monitor adoption and privacy concerns.
Dependencies: coordinate with ENG-34712 (token density rollout) for updated token names and with ENG-34121 (input focus refactor) for shared focus handling hooks.
accessibility_considerations: Use aria-describedby for linking inline hints and expanded messages so screen readers announce a concise hint first, then the expanded message when focused.
Provide a 'maskDescription' prop that apps can set to customize what is announced; default to 'characters hidden for privacy'.
Ensure any visual-only separators are implemented with role=presentation and are excluded from selection so screen readers don't read punctuation repeatedly.
Test with VoiceOver, TalkBack, NVDA on sample forms including email, phone, and credit card; record a11y test checklist in the ticket attachments.
localization_considerations: Decimal and grouping separators differ by locale; do not hardcode separators. Use Intl APIs where possible and provide opt-out for legacy locales.
Right-to-left layout: ensure suffix icons flip correctly and caret logic accounts for bidi text. Include RTL examples in Figma.
Number formatting for non-latin numerals: provide guidance to developers when automatic grouping should be disabled.
testing_plan: Unit tests for caret position preservation across insert/delete/paste sequences (include composition event scenarios).
Accessibility tests: axe snapshots + manual screen reader walkthroughs for 6 example pages.
Visual regression: Percy snapshots for compact/default/spacious densities and for invalid/valid states.
Integration smoke test: migrate billing page internal staging to new component and run end-to-end checkout flow.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge component with feature flag 'new-masked-input' and default to off for 2 weeks.
2) Enable for internal apps and product team beta, collect telemetry for caret-related errors and mask-reveal events.
3) Gradual enable by teams with migration guide and deprecation notice for legacy mask helper in 8 weeks.
4) Remove feature flag after 90% adoption and no regression signals for 2 weeks.
